mentions.name: Embeddable Typeform/Google Forms alternative
mentions.description: This is an embeddable Typeform/Google Forms alternative that integrates into existing applications and stores form data in the application's own database. Forms are defined in JSON Schema or JSON Forms, can be added or removed dynamically, and submissions are sent to the application's backend where they are stored in its database.
mentions.problem: Typeform and Google Forms don't integrate into existing applications or store form submissions in your own database.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a Typeform/Google Forms alternative that integrates into existing applications and stores data in your own database. It allows you to define forms in JSON Schema or JSON Forms. Forms can be added or removed dynamically, and submissions are sent to your backend and in turn stored in your database.
